title: Nick Chubb retires after eight seasons
summary: Former Browns and Texans running back Nick Chubb announced his retirement. He made four Pro Bowls and two second-team All-Pro teams in an eight-year career, most of it in Cleveland.
go2cupAngle: Chubb's career is a reminder of how much a running back can give a city. Cleveland fans watched him come back from serious injury more than once, and he leaves as one of the most respected players of his generation.

title: The NFL ends the Pro Bowl game after 88 years
summary: The league announced it will stop holding a Pro Bowl game. An 88-player Pro Bowl team will still be picked each season, and the players will be honored at a ceremony after the season instead of playing an all-star game.
go2cupAngle: It's the first of the four big US leagues to drop its all-star game, and honestly the game had lost its spark. Keeping the honor while dropping a low-intensity exhibition is a sensible call for player safety.
fanTravelImpact: Fans who planned winter trips around the Pro Bowl week events should watch for what the league puts in its place.

title: Seahawks open the season by beating the Patriots 13–10
summary: The defending champion Seattle Seahawks beat the New England Patriots 13–10 at Lumen Field in a Super Bowl LX rematch that opened the 2026 NFL season on September 9.
go2cupAngle: A low-scoring, defensive opener fits these two teams. Seattle showed why it's still the team to beat, and New England kept it close against the champs.
fanTravelImpact: Lumen Field is a short walk from downtown Seattle hotels, which makes it one of the easiest NFL road trips.

title: First NFL game in Australia: 49ers beat Rams 27–7 in Melbourne
summary: The San Francisco 49ers beat the Los Angeles Rams 27–7 at the Melbourne Cricket Ground, the first regular-season NFL game ever played in Australia.
go2cupAngle: The NFL is going truly global, and Melbourne's famous cricket ground was a great stage for it. The 49ers looked sharp after the long trip.
fanTravelImpact: International games are becoming yearly events. Fans who want to combine an NFL game with a big trip abroad now have more choices than ever.

title: Bears and Panthers set an opening-week scoring record
summary: Chicago beat Carolina 59–37, and the teams' 96 combined points set a record for a season opener, beating the old mark of 88.
go2cupAngle: A 59-point game on opening Sunday says a lot about how far the Bears' offense has come. Defenses around the league took notes.

title: Bills christen the new Highmark Stadium with a win over the Lions
summary: Buffalo played its first regular-season game in the new Highmark Stadium on Thursday Night Football, beating Detroit 41–31.
go2cupAngle: A new stadium and a statement win on national TV made for a perfect first night. Buffalo fans waited a long time for this building.
fanTravelImpact: The new stadium is in Orchard Park, outside Buffalo. Plan transport ahead for game days, and book early for big-name opponents.

title: Ravens win the NFL's first game in Brazil with a last-second field goal
summary: Baltimore beat Dallas 34–31 at the Maracanã in Rio de Janeiro on a walk-off field goal, in the first regular-season NFL game ever played in Brazil.
go2cupAngle: The Maracanã is soccer's cathedral, and it delivered a classic in its first NFL game. Brazilian fans got a finish worth the wait.
fanTravelImpact: Rio is also a host city for the 2027 Women's World Cup, so fans can plan a return trip next summer. See our Brazil 2027 guide.

title: Mike Ditka dies at 86
summary: Hall of Fame tight end and coach Mike Ditka died at 86. He won the Super Bowl as a player and as head coach of the 1985 Bears, and was twice named Coach of the Year.
go2cupAngle: Few people shaped a franchise like Ditka shaped the Bears. Chicago fans will remember the 1985 team forever, and so will the league.

title: Chiefs move to 5–0 with a 22–6 win over the Chargers
summary: Kenneth Walker ran for two touchdowns as Kansas City beat the Los Angeles Chargers 22–6 at Arrowhead to stay unbeaten. The Chiefs head to Seattle next for Sunday Night Football on October 25.
go2cupAngle: Five wins, five different ways. The defense held the Chargers without a touchdown, and the run game is giving Kansas City a new look.
fanTravelImpact: The Chiefs play at Seattle on Oct. 25. See our NFL page for the full schedule and hotels near Arrowhead for the next home game, against the Jets on Nov. 8.

title: Russell Westbrook retires after 18 seasons
summary: Former MVP Russell Westbrook announced his retirement. He played 18 seasons, won the 2017 MVP award and reached the 2012 NBA Finals with Oklahoma City.
go2cupAngle: Westbrook played every night at full speed. His triple-double seasons changed how we judge guards, and his energy will be missed.

title: NBA releases the 2026–27 schedule
summary: The league released its full regular-season schedule, with the NBA Cup, Christmas Day games and international games in Mexico City, Paris and Manchester.
go2cupAngle: The schedule is packed with big nights. The Christmas lineup and the European games show the league chasing new fans worldwide.
fanTravelImpact: Key dates and travel tips for every big NBA event are on our NBA page.

title: Clippers lose five first-round picks over the Kawhi Leonard salary cap scandal
summary: The NBA took five first-round picks (2029–2033) from the Clippers, fined the team $30 million and suspended owner Steve Ballmer for a year. Kawhi Leonard must pay the league $700,000.
go2cupAngle: These are some of the toughest penalties in league history. The message to every front office is clear: the salary cap rules apply to everyone.

title: NBA Cup courts unveiled ahead of the October 30 start
summary: The league showed off all 30 team courts for the NBA Cup. Group play starts October 30, and the championship is December 11 at historic Hinkle Fieldhouse in Indianapolis.
go2cupAngle: Moving the final from Las Vegas to Hinkle Fieldhouse is a great choice. Few gyms have more basketball history.
fanTravelImpact: Indianapolis is an easy drive or short flight from Kansas City. Book rooms near downtown early for the Dec. 11 final.

title: Knicks raise their first title banner in 53 years, then lose to the 76ers
summary: New York celebrated its 2026 championship before the opener at Madison Square Garden, then fell 106–100 to a new-look Philadelphia team led by LeBron James and Jaylen Brown.
go2cupAngle: A loss can't spoil a night 53 years in the making. Jalen Brunson's take was the right one: an early lesson is better than a late one.
fanTravelImpact: MSG games sell fast, and Knicks tickets are pricier than ever after the title. Plan early.

title: LeBron James starts his 24th season with the 76ers
summary: LeBron James made his Philadelphia debut at Madison Square Garden. He says he would have signed with the Knicks if they hadn't just won the title, so he chose a team still chasing one.
go2cupAngle: Picking the 76ers fits LeBron's love of a challenge. Philly fans finally have a star who has carried teams to titles before.

title: Edwards scores 45 as the Wolves spoil Giannis's Heat debut
summary: Anthony Edwards scored 45 in Minnesota's 131–106 win over Miami. Giannis Antetokounmpo had 35 in his first game for the Heat, but his teammates shot 26-of-62.
go2cupAngle: Pairing Edwards with new point guard LaMelo Ball looks dangerous already. For Miami, Giannis delivered; the supporting cast has to catch up.

title: Timberwolves bet big on LaMelo Ball
summary: Minnesota traded Naz Reid, an unprotected first-round pick, three pick swaps and three second-round picks to Charlotte for LaMelo Ball, pairing him with Anthony Edwards.
go2cupAngle: It's a bold swing for a team that has reached two straight conference finals. If the fit works, the Wolves could finally make the NBA Finals.

title: Wembanyama shoots 1-of-13 in the Spurs' opener against OKC
summary: Victor Wembanyama finished with 12 points, 13 rebounds and six blocks, but shot just 1-of-13 as last season's West champions lost to the Thunder.
go2cupAngle: One bad night doesn't change who Wemby is. His own words, "I need to think less," sound like a player who knows exactly how to fix it.

title: Brazil 2027 draw set for December 11 in Rio
summary: FIFA will hold the final draw for the 2027 Women's World Cup on December 11 at Rio de Janeiro's Museum of Modern Art. The full match schedule and host-city assignments come after the draw.
go2cupAngle: The draw is when Brazil 2027 becomes real for fans. Once the groups are set, the travel planning starts.
fanTravelImpact: Don't book match-city hotels until after Dec. 11, when FIFA publishes the schedule. Refundable options are your friend until then.

title: Toluca win the Leagues Cup in an all-Liga MX final
summary: Toluca beat Monterrey 2–0 in Houston to become the first Mexican club to win the Leagues Cup in its current format. Club León took third place over Club América.
go2cupAngle: An all-Liga MX final four is a wake-up call for MLS. Mexican clubs came to win this summer, and they did.
fanTravelImpact: Houston hosted the final, one more reason the city is becoming a soccer travel hub after the World Cup.

title: MLS sets its playoff dates, with MLS Cup on December 18
summary: MLS announced the playoff schedule: Decision Day is November 7, Wild Card matches are November 18, and MLS Cup is Friday, December 18. It's the last December final before the league moves to a summer-to-spring calendar.
go2cupAngle: The move to a summer-to-spring calendar is a big change. This year's playoffs close an era.
fanTravelImpact: The finalist with the better record hosts MLS Cup, so travel plans can only be locked in about a week before the final.

title: KC Current beat Utah 2–0 as the playoff push continues
summary: The Kansas City Current beat the Utah Royals 2–0 at America First Field on October 17. The Current have clinched a playoff spot with two regular-season games left.
go2cupAngle: Kansas City built a palace for women's soccer, and the team keeps rewarding the fans who fill it. Playoff soccer is coming to the riverfront.
fanTravelImpact: The Current's home finale is Fan Appreciation Day on Oct. 25 at CPKC Stadium. See our Soccer page for hotels near the stadium.

title: St. Louis CITY win the US Open Cup for the club's first trophy
summary: St. Louis CITY SC beat the Columbus Crew 5–3 on penalties after a 0–0 draw through 120 minutes, winning the US Open Cup and the first trophy in club history.
go2cupAngle: Missouri soccer had a big night. St. Louis has built a passionate fan base fast, and now it has silverware to show for it.

title: NWSL playoffs start November 6; the final is November 21 in Washington
summary: The NWSL playoff quarterfinals are November 6–8, the semifinals November 13–15, and the championship is November 21 at Audi Field in Washington, D.C., on CBS.
go2cupAngle: With the KC Current in, Kansas City fans have a real shot at a road trip to the final.
fanTravelImpact: Audi Field is in southwest D.C., close to Navy Yard hotels and the Metro. Book refundable rooms now if you're hoping for a KC final.

title: Makhachev keeps the welterweight belt at UFC 330
summary: Islam Makhachev beat Ian Machado Garry by unanimous decision to defend his welterweight title. On the same card, Mackenzie Dern kept her strawweight belt with a decision over Gillian Robertson.
go2cupAngle: Machado Garry pushed Makhachev for five rounds and earned a lot of respect. Makhachev keeps finding ways to win.

title: Joshua Van beats Pantoja at UFC 331
summary: Flyweight champion Joshua Van defeated Alexandre Pantoja by unanimous decision in a memorable title fight.
go2cupAngle: Beating a former champion like Pantoja silences the doubters. Van is the real deal at 125 pounds.

title: UFC 334 at Madison Square Garden: Gane vs. Hokit and Harrison vs. Nunes
summary: The UFC set two title fights for UFC 334 on November 14 in New York: Ciryl Gane vs. Josh Hokit at heavyweight and Kayla Harrison vs. Amanda Nunes for the women's bantamweight belt.
go2cupAngle: Harrison vs. Nunes is the biggest women's fight in years. Two legends, one belt, at the Garden.
fanTravelImpact: MSG cards sell out quickly, and Midtown hotels fill up on fight weekend. Book early. Hotels are linked on our UFC page.

title: Natália Silva wins the vacant flyweight title at UFC 332
summary: Brazil's Natália Silva beat Wang Cong by unanimous decision to win the vacant UFC women's flyweight championship.
go2cupAngle: Silva has been one of the most skilled fighters in the division for years. The belt finally matches her talent, and it's a big day for Brazilian MMA.

title: UFC 333 in Abu Dhabi: Volkanovski defends against Evloev
summary: Featherweight champion Alexander Volkanovski faces unbeaten Movsar Evloev at UFC 333 at the Etihad Arena in Abu Dhabi on October 24.
go2cupAngle: Evloev has earned his shot with years of wins. Volkanovski against a grinding wrestler is a real test, even for a great champion.
fanTravelImpact: Check current travel advisories before flying to the Gulf region this fall.

title: Fury vs. Joshua is set for December 11 in Cardiff
summary: Tyson Fury and Anthony Joshua will finally meet on Friday, December 11, in Cardiff, Wales, live on Netflix. Both have lost to Oleksandr Usyk in recent years.
go2cupAngle: It's ten years late, but it's still the biggest British fight possible. Both men are past their peaks, which may make it more competitive.
fanTravelImpact: Cardiff is about two hours by train from London. Hotels in the city center will go fast once tickets go on sale.

title: Zuffa Boxing passes 10 numbered events
summary: Zuffa Boxing, the promotion from the UFC's parent company, has held 10 numbered events, with fights streaming on Paramount+.
go2cupAngle: The UFC model is coming to boxing, with steady cards and one streaming home. It's worth watching whether top fighters stay.

title: Canelo vs. Mbilli in Riyadh to go ahead after airport attacks
summary: Organizers say Canelo Alvarez vs. Christian Mbilli for the WBC super middleweight title will go ahead on October 31 in Riyadh, after deadly attacks on Riyadh's airport.
go2cupAngle: Canelo's return is a big event, but the safety of fans and staff has to come first. Clear updates from organizers will matter in the days ahead.
fanTravelImpact: If you're traveling to Riyadh for the fight, check your government's travel advisory and your airline before you go.

title: Zuffa Boxing signs middleweight champion Carlos Adames
summary: WBC middleweight champion Carlos Adames (25-1-1, 18 KOs), The Ring's No. 1 middleweight, signed with Zuffa Boxing.
go2cupAngle: Landing a champion this good gives Zuffa real credibility at 160 pounds. Adames has been avoided for years, and now he should get big fights.

title: Dubois stops Wardley in two rounds to keep the WBO heavyweight title
summary: Daniel Dubois floored Fabio Wardley 17 seconds into their rematch at London's O2 Arena and stopped him in the second round to retain the WBO heavyweight belt.
go2cupAngle: A dominant night for Dubois. Wardley showed heart getting up, but Dubois was on another level.

title: Shakur Stevenson leaves Zuffa Boxing and becomes a free agent
summary: Unbeaten WBO 140-pound champion Shakur Stevenson (25-0) says Zuffa Boxing granted his release after three months. He plans to start his own promotional company.
go2cupAngle: Stevenson is one of the best boxers in the world. Wherever he lands, fans want to see him in the biggest fights possible.

title: Big fight weekend ahead: Navarrete vs. Foster in San Antonio
summary: On October 24, Emanuel Navarrete and O'Shaquie Foster unify junior lightweight titles in San Antonio, and Dalton Smith defends his WBC junior welterweight title against Alberto Puello in Sheffield.
go2cupAngle: A champion-vs-champion fight is exactly what boxing needs more of. Navarrete vs. Foster should be a war.
fanTravelImpact: San Antonio is an easy trip from Kansas City. Hotels on the River Walk are close to the fight.

title: Roger Federer inducted into the Tennis Hall of Fame
summary: Roger Federer and broadcaster Mary Carillo headlined the International Tennis Hall of Fame's Class of 2026 at the induction ceremony on August 29.
go2cupAngle: Federer's place was never in doubt. His grace on court set the standard for a whole generation.

title: Djokovic loses in the first round of the US Open
summary: Four-time champion Novak Djokovic was knocked out in the opening round, only the third time in his career he has lost in the first round of a major.
go2cupAngle: Even legends have off days. Djokovic has proven people wrong many times, so it's too early to write him off.

title: Shelton beats Alcaraz in a fifth-set tiebreak that ended after 3 a.m.
summary: Ben Shelton beat Carlos Alcaraz in a fifth-set tiebreak in the quarterfinals, in the match of the tournament. It didn't finish until 3:33 a.m.
go2cupAngle: Matches like this are why fans stay up all night. Shelton showed he can beat the very best on the biggest stage.
fanTravelImpact: Night sessions at the US Open can run very late. Plan your ride back from Queens before you go.

title: Rybakina wins her first US Open, beating Sabalenka
summary: Elena Rybakina beat defending champion Aryna Sabalenka 6–4, 5–7, 6–2 for her first US Open title and third Grand Slam. Maria Sharapova presented the trophy.
go2cupAngle: Rybakina's power was too much in the third set. Two majors in one season puts her at the top of the women's game.

title: Zverev beats Shelton to win the US Open
summary: Alexander Zverev beat Ben Shelton 6–3, 7–6, 5–7, 6–2 for his first US Open title and second major. He is the first German man to win the US Open since 1989.
go2cupAngle: After years of near-misses in New York, Zverev finally won it. Shelton's run proves American men's tennis is back.

title: Townsend and Siniaková complete a career Grand Slam
summary: Taylor Townsend and Kateřina Siniaková won the US Open women's doubles title, completing a career Grand Slam as a team.
go2cupAngle: A milestone for one of the best doubles teams of this era, and a proud moment for American tennis.

title: Muchová claims the last spot at the WTA Finals in Indian Wells
summary: Karolína Muchová secured the final qualifying place for the WTA Finals, which run November 8–15 at the Indian Wells Tennis Garden in California.
go2cupAngle: Moving the WTA Finals to Indian Wells puts the season finale back in front of American crowds. Muchová's talent makes her a dangerous floater.
fanTravelImpact: Indian Wells is in the Palm Springs area. Book desert hotels early; November is high season.

title: Norris wins the last Dutch Grand Prix at Zandvoort
summary: Lando Norris won the Dutch Grand Prix, the last F1 race at Zandvoort, after a red flag for Max Verstappen's crash on the first lap. Kimi Antonelli finished second and extended his championship lead.
go2cupAngle: Zandvoort's farewell had plenty of drama. It's a shame to lose one of the sport's most atmospheric tracks.

title: Antonelli wins at Monza from 19th on the grid
summary: Kimi Antonelli won the Italian Grand Prix from 19th on the grid, the first Italian to win at Monza in 60 years and the lowest starting position for a winner since 1983.
go2cupAngle: This is the kind of drive that defines a career. An Italian winning at Monza from the back will be remembered for decades.

title: Antonelli wins the first Spanish GP at Madrid's new Madring
summary: Kimi Antonelli won the first Spanish Grand Prix at the new Madring circuit in Madrid, ahead of Max Verstappen and Lando Norris.
go2cupAngle: Madrid put on a good first show. A new city race brings F1 closer to a huge new audience.
fanTravelImpact: Madrid is easy to reach from the US with direct flights, which makes the Spanish GP an appealing F1 trip for American fans.

title: Russell wins in Baku by 0.196 seconds
summary: George Russell won the Azerbaijan Grand Prix from pole, leading every lap for his first career grand slam. He held off Max Verstappen by 0.196 seconds, the closest finish in more than 20 years.
go2cupAngle: A perfect weekend for Russell, and the closest of finishes. Baku keeps producing classics.

title: Verstappen wins the rain-hit Bahrain GP, held in Malaysia
summary: Max Verstappen won his first race of the season at the Bahrain Grand Prix, moved to Malaysia's Sepang circuit after the original April race was called off. It was the first win for a Ford-powered car since 2003.
go2cupAngle: Red Bull and Ford needed this. Verstappen in the rain is still a special sight.

title: Verstappen wins in Singapore for back-to-back victories
summary: Max Verstappen won the Singapore Grand Prix, his first ever at Marina Bay, ahead of Charles Leclerc and Kimi Antonelli. He also won the rain-hit sprint the day before.
go2cupAngle: Two wins in a row means Red Bull is back in the fight for wins. The title race is still Antonelli's to lose, but the final races just got more interesting.

title: F1 heads to Austin for the US Grand Prix, October 23–25
summary: Round 18 is the United States Grand Prix at Circuit of the Americas in Austin. After that come Mexico City, São Paulo, Las Vegas, Qatar and the Abu Dhabi finale on December 6.
go2cupAngle: Antonelli leads, but Verstappen arrives in form. American fans get two of the last six races, in Austin and Las Vegas.
fanTravelImpact: Austin is a short flight from Kansas City. Hotels near the circuit and downtown fill up fast on race weekend. See our F1 page.

title: MLS playoff race: 9 of 18 spots clinched
summary: With Decision Day on November 7, Chicago, Inter Miami, Nashville and New England have clinched in the East, and Dallas, Houston, San Jose, St. Louis and Vancouver in the West.
go2cupAngle: Three of the clinched teams are a day's drive from Kansas City (Dallas, Houston, St. Louis), so playoff soccer road trips are on the table.
fanTravelImpact: Playoff home games are set only days ahead. Pick a refundable hotel if you plan to follow a team.

title: UFC heads to Doha: Prochazka vs. Stirling on November 21
summary: Former light heavyweight champion Jiří Procházka headlines a UFC Fight Night against Navajo Stirling at ABHA Arena in Doha, Qatar, on November 21.
go2cupAngle: Procházka is one of the most exciting fighters in the sport. Any card he headlines is worth watching.
fanTravelImpact: Doha also hosts the Qatar F1 Grand Prix a week later (Nov. 27–29). Check travel advisories for the region before booking.
